# @surfaces-ui/next

Serve Surfaces UI pages from a Next.js app: routes, metadata and server-rendered pages, with Next.js doing the routing, building and hosting.

## Install

```bash
npm install @surfaces-ui/next next react react-dom
```

`next` and `react` and `react-dom` are peer dependencies: your app provides them.

## Part of Surfaces UI

Surfaces UI is a UI library for data and analytics: exploring schemas, querying, charting, tables at scale, chat, and pages an agent can build.

Every Surfaces UI package is released at the same version; install them all at that one version, since mixing releases is not supported.
